plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-15 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). Program page states the pathways are for catalog year 2026-2027 and the map is headed 'English map for 2026-2027'. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. This plan transcribes the first/default pathway, 'English Option 01' (to CSU), in full; it is a Bakersfield College-only map with no second-institution section. The program page lists two further Option 02 pathways for the same AA-T credential (one a Transfer Pathway whose CSU Bakersfield continuation, English - Language and Literature BA at 60 units, is a different institution's degree, and one a further to-CSU pattern); neither is a separate Bakersfield College degree and neither is collected as a separate plan. The transcribed map prints the degree total as a range, 60-63 units, and term totals as 15-16.5 / 15-16.5 / 15 / 15. Ranged rows: Term 1 'Area 1A : English Composition' (3-4.5) and Term 2 'Area 2 : Mathematical Concepts and Quantitative Reasoning' (3-4.5). Per the standing minimum-credit convention every ranged row is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 60 units. ENGL C1001 and ENGL C1002 are each printed with the dual category label 'Major / Gen Ed'; they are named major courses and are recorded with category 'major'. The Term 2 'Major List A' slot is likewise printed 'Major / Gen Ed' and is recorded as a major choice slot; the Term 3 'Major List A' slot is printed 'Major' only. ENGL C1001 shows a 'Prerequisites' flag in Card View; the map does not print the specific prerequisite courses, so no prereqs are recorded and the flag is disclosed on that course row. No other row shows a flag. General-education, major-list and elective slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. The map page states verbatim: 'This program map represents one possible pathway through the program and may not reflect the most current catalog requirements. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan that fits your needs.' The map also prints the footnote: 'Program maps are for reference only. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan or visit CSU Transfer Planner for more options.'
